card.name: Linking words before antipsychotic or drug class
card.fires_on: The small linking words "with" or "of" right after "treatment", "treated" or "therapy", just before a named drug class such as antipsychotics or AEDs. Seen in warning-section prose.

modes.label: with after treat-
modes.description: "with" following "treatment" or "treated" and ahead of a drug class.
modes.example: Hyperglycemia, in some cases extreme and associated with ketoacidosis or hyperosmolar coma or death, has been reported in patients treated<< with>> atypical antipsychotics including F

modes.label: of after therapy
modes.description: "of" after a bracketed therapy phrase, ahead of a number and drug group.
modes.example: and/or any unusual changes in mood or behavior. Pooled analyses of 199 placebo-controlled clinical trials (mono- and adjunctive therapy)<< of>> 11 different AEDs showed
